entries.content_plain: 14-16. God Himself speaks (compare Psa 46:10 ; 75:2 , 3 ). All the terms to express safety and peace indicate the most undoubting confidence (compare Psa 18:2 ; 20:1 ; 22:5 ). set his love-- that of the most ardent kind.
